profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin
profile.geoLocationName: Tompkins County, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I have 18 years of professional experience in embedded software engineering, working on system software as well as test equipment development.  My most recent experience is test system development utilizing MS C#.

Knowledgeable in software tool sets from Wind River, National Instruments, Green Hills Software and Microsoft.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Broad spectrum experience in embedded systems programming, from built in test to application software on avionics processors and network switches.  Currently involved in automatic test system development and test.
positions.insights: Skills: Test Automation · Automatic Test Equipment · C# · C++ · Avionics · Embedded Software · Continuous Integration (CI)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop Functional Test Software (FTS) hosted on target hardware to exercise I/O and data subsystems of units under test.

Integrate FTS software with Special Test Equipment (STE) test stand software developed with LabWindows CVI and Test Stand.

Develop, test and integrate embedded driver software developed in C hosted on WindRiver VxWorks 653 and Green Hills Integrity operating systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Currently involved in a number of avionics software programs.
Supported diagnostic software built in the Visual Studio IDE, updating legacy projects up to build with Studio 2008.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Responsible for requirements development, working directly with the customer in support of the upgrade to the Boeing 747-8 MAWEA system.

• Became subject matter expert on the Intel 8051 architecture, acting as a technical focal point in support of the software team as an expert in designing and implementing code solutions.

• Developed Fortran test driver files to verify the system-level integration of the software and hardware and to verify that the software correctly implemented the requirements.

• Resolved a number of decade-old problem reports in the course of new development work, many related to fixed-point arithmetical errors and memory mapping errors in the legacy implementation.

• Developed Perl scripting tools to facilitate the conversion of project code base from the HP 64000 VAX hosted toolset for use in the Keil IDE.  Played a key role in final debugging of the conversion process.

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed Ada test driver software in support of the certification of avionics software on the Boeing 777 OPAS system.

• Developed Ada application software for the Boeing 777 freighter ECSMC system.

• Developed Ada test driver software in support of the certification of avionics software on the Boeing 777 OPAS system.

• Other responsibilities included Computer Program Verification test support, in-depth review and analysis of software requirements and release documentation received from the customer and code analysis for forthcoming software development.

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed, implemented and tested new diagnostics and software driver code using the C programming language hosted on the WindRiver vxWorks platform in support of new I/O devices for a display unit on the US101 Presidential Helicopter Replacement Program at Lockheed Martin Systems Integration, Owego, NY.

• Issued SECRET clearance.

positions.title: Programmer / Analyst - Contract
positions.description: • Developed test driver software to verify real-time embedded avionics software to written in Ada, C and assembly code to achieve DO-178B Level A test coverage on a number of digital flight control systems at BAE Systems, Johnson City, NY.

positions.title: Systems Analyst
positions.description:
• Applied PC troubleshooting skills to rapidly and accurately address customer requests.

• Supported metrology lab database applications.

positions.title: Technologist
positions.description:
• Co-inventor on U.S. Patent 6,582,845 (20030624), Solid oxide electrolyte, fuel cell module, and method.  
• Designed and executed experiments in a research laboratory setting in support of the Cellular Ceramics department’s research efforts in a number of research projects.
